t: You're looking at the Cardinal Vaughan Memorial School, a Roman Catholic secondary school and sixth form in Holland Park, with around a thousand students. It takes its name from Herbert Vaughan, who became Archbishop of Westminster in 1892 and a cardinal the next year. He founded the Mill Hill Missionaries and the Catholic Truth Society, and led the building of Westminster Cathedral. The school was founded by Henry Fitzalan-Howard, the fifteenth Duke of Norfolk, a Unionist politician best remembered for his philanthropy, which focused on Roman Catholic causes.
